item.title: License: Apache-2.0 + DCO (no CLA)
item.value: Apache-2.0 is the verified ecosystem norm — 5/6 direct comparables use it (Mem0 58.3k★, Graphiti 27.3k★, Letta 23.2k★, Vibe Kanban 26.9k★, claude-mem 81.6k★ with explicit embed-everywhere rationale; only claude-flow is MIT). AGPL solves a nonexistent threat (nobody cloud-wraps a localhost daemon requiring each user's own Claude Code) while triggering enterprise dev-machine bans; BSL/dual contradicts the first-with-receipts brand. Apache patent grant matters because our moat claims are mechanisms. Hosted-later needs no relicensing — open-core on top. DCO not CLA (zero friction; solo authorship + inbound=outbound preserves flexibility). Replace the placeholder MIT LICENSE; copyright under real name, add NOTICE.

item.title: Launch BEFORE bench v4 — existence proof + honest nulls framing
item.value: Decision: do not block launch on bench v4 (the lift proof). v4 is a research outcome that can't be scheduled to succeed; the window is months-not-quarters. Launch framing: n=2 held-out causal wins (0/8→8/8, zero variance) + 8 published nulls + retracted net-tokens metric + quantified over-deliberation tax IS the first-with-receipts story — pre-v4 honesty differentiates harder than a clean win. v4 runs in parallel during the private-beta window; if it lands by launch, promote to headline; if null, publish anyway (additive, not retraction — the framing forbids over-claiming so a null can't hurt). v4 result (win OR null) otherwise headlines the W7-9 benchmark-publication content beat.

item.title: Fresh-repo cut, not history rewrite
item.value: Verified 2026-06-10: agents.json (per-machine runtime state) was tracked earlier in the orchestrator repo's 69-commit history, and 15+ tracked bench files contain /Users/imyu/... personal paths (bench/heldout JSONL transcripts are highest-risk). Recommendation: cut a fresh public repo from the swept current tree (single/curated initial commits); keep the old repo private as true history. 69 commits have near-zero archaeology value to outsiders and filter-repo rewrites still leak via reflog/forks. Sweep: grep for imyu|gao|sk-ant|api[_-]?key|token, parameterize absolute paths in bench scripts/specs, confirm certs/token/overlay/sessions/logs absent.

item.title: Critical path = name ratification + same-day handle reservation
item.value: The single critical-path item: ratify Varve and reserve npm/PyPI/crates/GitHub org/domain/X handle the SAME DAY — the only precondition with an external clock (C1 showed the namespace closing: trellis/weft/engram/lamarck all claimed within 4 months). Everything else parallelizes behind it. Timeline from T0: W0-1 repo cut+sweep+README, W1-3 private beta (5-10 users from Claude Code power users/Discord/r/ClaudeAI; v4 runs in this slack), W3-4 soft public + plugin listing (review latency starts early), W5-6 Show HN receipts post, W7-9 held-out memory-win protocol publication beat. Launch ~mid-July 2026. Keep Coppice as vetted backup name + tested 1-day rename script.

item.title: Don't-block list + v0.x signal + dogfood changelog
item.value: DON'T block launch on: context-gate wiring (ship as documented offline module, labeled not-live — hiding it violates the brand), multi-CLI, hosted anything (silence — mentioning invites BSL suspicion), dashboard polish, Windows (honest 'not yet'; Linux MUST pass cold — add container smoke test before soft-public). Launch as v0.9.0; reserve 1.0 for: lift proven + context-gate live + native-format compatibility story (canary+snapshot+pinned version). Weekly releases first 8 weeks. Dogfood: generate the changelog from the graph itself (completed-task summaries + supersede chains since last tag) — standing demo that the changelog is a query over the product. Deprecation rule for delete-and-ride removals: warn in prior minor naming the native replacement, remove no earlier than next minor.
